verdict.rationale: Viam's official CLI documents deleting captured data and tagging all data that matches a filter, so user-controlled deletion is a first-party capability. However, nothing in the evidence shows configurable retention periods or automatic expiry policies. The local-queue 'storage constraints handled automatically' note is adjacent behavior, not user-controlled retention. Missing for 10: documented retention policy or TTL configuration, deletion via SDK/API or UI beyond a one-line CLI mention, detail on deletion scope and guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
